themes.name: Education and Student Support
themes.rule: Proposals that improve schools, teaching, learning opportunities, or student meals and academic support belong here.

themes.name: Affordable and Accessible Housing
themes.rule: Proposals that increase, preserve, regulate, or improve the affordability and availability of homes and student housing belong here.

themes.name: Waste Reduction and Recycling
themes.rule: Proposals that reduce disposable waste or improve household collection, recycling, composting, or material recovery belong here.

themes.name: Arts and Cultural Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand public art, performances, festivals, museums, or arts instruction belong here.

themes.name: Digital City Services
themes.rule: Proposals that move city services, information, connectivity, or assistance with digital access online or into unified access channels belong here.

themes.name: Local Jobs and Business Support
themes.rule: Proposals that support small businesses, coworking, licensing, workforce retraining, or local hiring belong here.

themes.name: Transit and Active Travel
themes.rule: Proposals that improve public-transit service, fares, rider information, or cycling infrastructure belong here.

themes.name: Parks and Neighborhood Amenities
themes.rule: Proposals that create or improve parks, playgrounds, gardens, street trees, dog areas, or other shared outdoor neighborhood spaces belong here.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Proposals that expand medical care, mental-health support, preventive screening, specialist access, or in-home care belong here.

themes.name: Public Safety and Emergency Response
themes.rule: Proposals that prevent crime or traffic injuries, improve street safety, strengthen policing, or reduce emergency response times belong here.

themes.name: Clean Energy and Air Quality
themes.rule: Proposals that monitor or reduce air pollution or shift municipal operations toward renewable energy belong here.
